sourceText:
CIN_F003_FATALITE_1 · La pointe et le silence
Il fixe un xénomorphe avec la lance puis tranche au shuriken ; la géométrie et les éclaboussures acides utilisent le module de victime xéno.
Déclenchement : Seulement après victoire finale, contre une menace hostile adulte ; interdite en entraînement, entre alliés ou sur un civil désarmé.
0–1 s : intention lisible ; 1–3 s : geste ; 3–5 s : pose de sortie. Taunt cible 0,8–1,2 s. Durées proposées.
Sprite : F003_CIN_FATALITE_1 · objets : E_F003_shuriken ; E_F003_plasma
Lore : Ne pas anticiper la marque au début du récit ; alliance avec Lex, fin alternative signalée.

historicalReview.notes: Six independently articulated drawings for each facing, with preparation, equipment action and recovery. Feet and complete weapon tips visually inspected; all six source cells per orientation have clear alpha gutters and zero visible border pixels. One fixed body reference per native page, no per-pose fitting. Horizontal pivots manually reviewed between actual supporting feet; vertical candidates reviewed as feet, not weapon tips. Original PNG copied byte-identically. No mirror, rigging, crop rewrite, chroma cleanup or pixel editing. BODY-only visual sequence: source mechanical phases and inventory/duel synchronization remain separate. Real pin, retrieve closedshuriken, unfold, cut, withdraw/retract and exit; ONEshuriken only. Hip belt is empty after retrieval while opened weapon is held, without inventing a second device or holster lore. Xenomorph, acid and contact geometry are external scene dependencies; no partner is painted and no duel execution synchronized. Fixed per-page body references exclude spear/star extents. Two independent pages preserve six real stages per direction; every admitted PNG remains byte-identical to imagegen output. Independent engine and QA source/anatomy review approved as BODY study only; fixed mask-to-soles references per native page, public copies byte-identical and SHA-verified.
